plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says it is historical fact that Jack Parsons, an American rocket pioneer, practiced sex magic in the style of the occultist Aleister Crowley out in the California desert in the 1940s. According to Michels, he did it alongside L. Ron Hubbard, the man who founded the religious movement Scientology. Michels tells it to show how strangely the founders of American rocketry mixed science with magic.
